info.name: Slash Infotech CRM - Task Timer & Working Hours (Phase 6.3.3)
info.description: Comprehensive Postman API Collection covering all 8 endpoints of Phase 6.3.3: Play, Pause, Resume, Stop, Active Timer, Time Entries, Task Time Summary, and My Time Summary. Enforces server-authoritative UTC timestamps, single running timer rule via MySQL STORED generated columns, Asia/Kolkata midnight calendar splits, and strict cross-employee isolation.

request.description: Starts or resumes working on a task. Automatically advances task status from TODO to IN_PROGRESS. If another task is currently running, it is atomically auto-paused with reason TASK_SWITCH. Enforces at most one running timer per employee.

response.name: 200 OK - Timer Started (Fresh)
200 OK - Task Switched
403 Forbidden - Not Assigned

request.description: Pauses the running task timer with a manual reason (TEA_BREAK, LUNCH, PERSONAL_WORK, MEETING, WAITING, TECHNICAL_ISSUE, OTHER). System reasons TASK_SWITCH and LOGOUT are strictly forbidden. OTHER requires customDescription.

response.name: 200 OK - Timer Paused (TEA_BREAK)
400 Bad Request - System Reason Impersonation Rejected
400 Bad Request - OTHER Without customDescription

request.description: Demonstrates manual pause with reason OTHER and required customDescription.

response.name: 200 OK - Paused with OTHER

request.description: Resumes a paused task. Closes the open pause record, sets resumedAt and followingTimeEntryId, and creates a fresh running work entry.

response.name: 200 OK - Timer Resumed

request.description: Explicitly stops the task work session. Closes the running entry and any open pause. Does NOT mark task COMPLETED; preserves task status IN_PROGRESS.
Returns the employee's currently active timer if running, or their most recent paused task session if paused. Returns isRunning, isPaused, and live server-calculated elapsedSeconds.

response.name: 200 OK - Active Running Timer
200 OK - No Active Timer

request.description: Returns chronological work entries and associated pause intervals for a specific task. Accessible to the assignee and authorized supervisors within data scope.
Calculates aggregated working time, pause duration, number of work sessions, and daily breakdown for a single task. Correctly splits overnight work at Asia/Kolkata midnight (18:30:00 UTC).
Returns the authenticated employee's working and paused time aggregated across all tasks. Includes calendar daily breakdown and task-by-task breakdown.

response.name: 200 OK - My Time Summary
